woman.audio_profile: A young woman hiding in a dark department store, terrified, whispering into a walkie-talkie so nothing hears her.

scene: Heard over a cheap walkie-talkie in an empty building at night.
sample_context: A radio call during a zombie outbreak.

chunks.text: [whispering, frightened] Is anyone still in the mall? I'm on the second floor of the department store... Please. I'm not alone up here.
